correctness.rationale: The ordinary depth-three tree-shattering recursion is exact after deduplicating identical open-neighborhood rows. A depth-three witness retains at most 7 query vertices plus 8 distinct realizing centers, so every induced-minimal threshold obstruction has <=15 vertices. Iterating all 32767 creation words from orders 1..15 is exhaustive by the threshold creation characterization. Independently implemented full enumeration exactly reproduced rank-three positives (0,0,0,0,0,0,0,3,23,101,337,954,2426,5734,12878) and only the 3 listed eight-vertex and 1 listed nine-vertex deletion-minimal words. Independently regenerated complete 8-leaf depth-three trees match the stored certificate query structures/leaf centers; all one-vertex deletions were retested after restricting query domains. The three-case split-graph nesting argument rules out shattering any static 3-set, and direct checks verify VC<=2 on all four witnesses. These bounded exhaustive checks prove the global statement only together with the separate 15-vertex reduction, not by extrapolation.
residual_risks: The exhaustive-census component relies on the stated exact recurrence and the complete 2^(n-1) word coverage; the independently implemented logic reproduces both.
A finite census alone is not a proof beyond 15 vertices; the constructive witness cutoff supplies that step.

value.rationale: The claim exactly characterizes a natural adaptive learning/model-theory invariant on the canonical hereditary threshold-graph class. The four minimal induced obstructions give a concrete and usable structure theorem and a fixed-size certificate for failure of rank<=2, with the sharp first possible order eight and a strict separation from the static VC=2 bound. The proof-required finite census covers a mathematically forced cutoff, not an arbitrary slice, and an independent researcher could use precisely this obstruction basis in graph-class learning or stability arguments.
residual_risks: Does not classify Ldim values >=4; value is the complete rank-two forbidden-subgraph boundary.
No independent downstream application is established, but the obstruction basis itself is a natural exact structural invariant.
